propositions: reopen lacks parent-first cascade unlike claim and transition, allowing a closed parent to remain closed when its child is reopened to open
the cascade seam only fires on open->in_progress edge, not on closed->open edge where it is needed to maintain the invariant that a parent is never more closed than its children
reopening a child under a closed parent should transitively reopen parent ancestors to the root in one invocation, fail-fast, with the parent moving before the child

the cascade must treat benign races (parent status changes between decision and write) identically to claim_compute, re-checking parent status on failure and allowing child to proceed if parent already moved out of eligible status

cascade edges must be generalized into a single table-driven implementation to prevent divergence in error handling, cycle guards, and fail-fast semantics between open->in_progress and closed->open transitions
